title: Add AI Flashcards to learn
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [AI Flashcards](https://chibbit-99.github.io/flashcardgen) to learn
- Create AI flashcards. Helps turn content into study cards for review.

Fixes #11210

gist.headline: Study cards, freshly pollinated
gist.blurb: AI Flashcards has joined the learn garden. Feed it some content and it grows a tidy stack of study cards for the part where your brain has to remember things.
gist.summary: Added AI Flashcards to the learn app directory, giving learners a tool that turns content into AI-generated study cards for review.
gist.impact: Users can now discover AI Flashcards through pollinations.ai learn resources and turn their material into review-ready flashcards.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy study nook with Polli acting as a tiny librarian or student, arranging a stack of glowing AI-generated flashcards beside a retro terminal. Flashcards sprout like code-plants from a flower pot, representing content being transformed into memorable study material.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush and light blue wings, wearing tiny round study glasses and carefully sorting glowing flashcards at a warm retro desk; a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant grows card-shaped leaves from a flower pot beside a CRT monitor. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, warm cream and lavender study nook, subtle pixel-font text: 'AI FLASHCARDS', nostalgic but beautiful.
